hooks.prompt: First, run `git diff --name-only HEAD` to check if any source files (.ts, .tsx) were modified. If no source files changed, do nothing and stop. If source files changed, determine which packages under `packages/` were affected and run `pnpm --filter <package> typecheck` and `pnpm --filter <package> test` only for those packages. If any checks fail, fix the issues and re-run the failing checks to confirm the fix.
